# Node/Express SAST Scan

Read state and checkpoint first, then focus on Express app/router routes, route modules, middleware order, controller imports, Mongo/SQL queries, JWT, CORS, helmet, cookies, templates, child_process, filesystem, redirects, SSRF, prototype pollution, mass assignment, and authorization.
